'''Chuhkyvi''' was the language spoken by the [[Chuhkyvi]], a [[Water/Legends|water]]-breathing [[Species/Legends|species]] [[Homeworld/Legends|indigenous]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Aquaris/Legends|Aquaris]].
